name: FounderTwoFactor
description: Two-step sign-in in Founder Control Center: the same screens as HubTwoFactorSetup and HubTwoFactorVerify, with the Founder mark: AuthLayout with `brand="founder"` (S63). - **The panel:** the Ventora mark next to "Founder", "Control Center" and "Instrumentul intern al echipei Ventora". There is no language selector. - **Required for everyone:** "Contul Founder are acces la toate afacerile, așa că îl protejăm cu un al doilea pas. În Founder e obligatoriu pentru toți." - **Language:** Founder stays in Romanian (S57), but every text is a key in `i18n/two-factor.json`. - **Shown:** 1280 and 390, in light and dark — activation step 1 and verification as full screens, then on phone step 2 with a wrong code, step 3, the backup code, locked, and no access.
states: Founder Control Center — autentificarea în doi pași, obligatorie pentru toți
notes: States are the labelled boards and frames of the preview (Light and Dark; desktop/tablet/phone).
